warning_source: 6 former police commissioners and 42 retired deputy commissioners
progress: Resolved existing candidate. Contemporaneous Ynet reporting reproduces the direct letter warning Netanyahu of the expected/impending collapse of Israel Police; Times of Israel independently confirms the addressee, six former commissioners, 42 deputy commissioners, core wording and request for a direct meeting to present strengthening proposals. Published to Notion as WARN-7 / High confidence. Classified as a general internal-security/readiness warning, not an Oct. 7 or Gaza-specific prediction.
gaps: No specific Netanyahu response to the letter recovered. Ynet on June 11 records Netanyahu separately acknowledging inadequate police manpower, but this is not treated as proof of a response to the letter. Original government receipt record not recovered; contemporaneous published reproduction is strong.

recipient: Knesset State Control Committee; government-level recipient unresolved
progress: Contemporaneous testimony: Shabtai warned that police could not handle a nationwide multi-front outbreak because of shortages of manpower, resources, means and equipment. Police Operations Division chief Sigal Bar Zvi said the force was preparing for 106 simultaneous violent locations but could answer only 68 and lacked 4,000 Border Police reservists.
gaps: Recover Knesset protocol/primary transcript and establish whether the warning was delivered to or formally transmitted to a serving government decision-maker before acceptance. Do not infer Oct. 7 causation.

warning_source: Itay Hoffman / national military-security coordinators organization
recipient: Yoav Gallant / Defense Ministry; exact meeting date and record unresolved
progress: Contemporaneous Walla reporting on June 5 documented systemic gaps in military security coordinators: fragmented authority, low staffing incentives, limited authority and dependence on multiple bodies, while explicitly describing the risk that an infiltrator could reach a nearby community before regular forces and massacre civilians. Five days after Oct. 7, Hoffman said the organization had asked in Defense Ministry meetings to restore long guns to emergency squads, reverse cuts that reduced some squads from 16 members to 5-6, and restore protected/security vehicles; he said Gallant was the only recent defense minister who met them, about five months earlier.
gaps: Need contemporaneous meeting minutes, letter, calendar/Defense Ministry confirmation or independent corroboration of the specific requests made to Gallant before acceptance. The June 5 article corroborates the underlying preparedness complaints but not the exact Gallant-meeting content.

recipient: Defense Ministry and IDF institutional responsibility; current-officeholder receipt unresolved
progress: Official State Comptroller reporting published May 12, 2026 says problems in the employment/status framework of military security coordinators had been identified in previous audits yet remained uncorrected for about 20 years; the Comptroller says the fragmented subordination, low pay and unresolved status impair coordinators' ability to perform their role. This materially strengthens the inherited-readiness context.
gaps: Not yet a distinct accepted warning event to the current government. Recover dated pre-Oct. 7 audit recommendations, formal follow-up, and evidence of receipt/repetition to current officeholders; preserve IDF/MOD responses and responsibility boundaries.
